question: ABC is an equilateral triangle. If the area of the triangle is 36√3, then what is the radius of circle circumscribing the triangle ABC ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Area of equilateral triangle = (√3 / 4) × side² = 36√3

⇒ side² = 36 × 4 = 144 ⇒ side = 12

Direct Formula: Circumradius (R) = side / √3

⇒ R = 12 / √3 = 4√3

**∴ The correct answer is 4√3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Area of equilateral triangle ABC = 36√3

**Formula Used:**

1. Area of equilateral triangle = (√3 / 4) × a² (where a is the side)

2. Circumradius (R) of equilateral triangle = a / √3

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af0375dc969168c00f3e4b0940e5bfc75a2443d9dbd253cccfc92d9a5bf7d024.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Area = (√3 / 4) × a² = 36√3

⇒ a² = (36√3 × 4) / √3

⇒ a² = 144

⇒ a = √144 = 12

⇒ Circumradius (R) = a / √3

⇒ R = 12 / √3

⇒ R = (4 × 3) / √3

⇒ R = 4√3

**∴ The correct answer is 4√3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Inradius of Equilateral Triangle

The radius of the incircle (r) is given by r = a / (2√3). It is exactly half of the circumradius (R = 2r).

Height of Equilateral Triangle

The altitude or height (h) is given by h = (√3 / 2) × a. Note that h = R + r = 3r.

Area in terms of Height

The area of an equilateral triangle can also be calculated as Area = h² / √3.</p
